what: Hovering the pill button stretches a ”band color 50% → base color” gradient panel from outside the button’s left edge to 4× the button width beyond its right end in .4s ease-in-out, so the button is covered with the band color from the left, and the text turns white over .4s starting .1s later, each character .025s later than the last. On release, a ”base color 50% → band color” panel sweeps the same path from the left back to the base color — both entering and leaving sweep left to right

options.delay: Delay before the first letter tints (sec), default .1
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Child elements to split the text into single characters (if none, text stays as is)

use: Join Us
note: On touch devices, the same motion is applied to focus·blur

from.where: index.html recruit section .sm-join (original .recruitBtn.fn-hoverBtn — ::before·::after left −100%·right 100% → −300% .4s ease-in-out, mouseIn·mouseOut classes, .splitTxt color .4s ease-in-out, data-delayset t,0,.1,.025)
